description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_3DModel" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3d-model">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches and project request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Draft" name="Draft model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Changes" name="Requested changes"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Model approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL file"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Start_SendSketches</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches and request a project" messageRef="Message_Sketches">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Start_SendSketches</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_SendSketches_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft model" messageRef="Message_Draft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_SendSketches_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_SendChanges_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_ReceiveDraft_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewModel" name="Review model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_ReceiveDraft_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Review_Satisfied</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ModelSatisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Review_Satisfied</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Satisfied_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_NotSatisfied_Changes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApproval" name="Approve model" messageRef="Message_Approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Satisfied_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Approval_ReceiveSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Message_Changes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_NotSatisfied_Changes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_SendChanges_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive STL file" messageRef="Message_STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Approval_ReceiveSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_ReceiveSTL_ChooseColor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_ReceiveSTL_ChooseColor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_ChooseColor_InStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorInStock" name="Is the color at home?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_ChooseColor_InStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_InStock_CheckAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_NotInStock_Order</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check amount of color left">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_InStock_CheckAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_CheckAmount_Under100</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Under 100 grams?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_CheckAmount_Under100</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Under100_AddList</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_AtLeast100_MergeStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Under100_AddList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_AddList_MergeStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeStockAmount">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_AddList_MergeStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_AtLeast100_MergeStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_MergeStock_OrderMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_NotInStock_Order</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_OrderColor_OrderMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeColorHandling">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_MergeStock_OrderMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_OrderColor_OrderMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_ColorHandling_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printer and G-code">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_ColorHandling_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Split_Heat</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Split_GCode</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder">
      <bpmn:documentation>The printer continuously sends its status during heating.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Split_Heat</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Heat_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGCode" name="Generate G-code from the STL file">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Split_GCode</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_GCode_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printer and G-code ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Heat_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_GCode_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Join_Print</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Join_Print</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Print_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ModelPrinted" name="Model printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Print_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Start_SendSketches" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_SendSketches_ReceiveDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_ReceiveDraft_Review" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Task_ReviewModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Review_Satisfied" sourceRef="Task_ReviewModel" targetRef="Gateway_ModelSatisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Satisfied_Approval" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_ModelSatisfied" targetRef="Task_SendApproval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NotSatisfied_Changes" name="Not satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_ModelSatisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_SendChanges_ReceiveDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Approval_ReceiveSTL" sourceRef="Task_SendApproval" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_ReceiveSTL_ChooseColor" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_ChooseColor_InStock" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorInStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_InStock_CheckAmount" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NotInStock_Order" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_OrderColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_CheckAmount_Under100" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Under100_AddList" name="Under 100 grams" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountInGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_AtLeast100_MergeStock" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_MergeStockAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountInGrams >= 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_AddList_MergeStock" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_MergeStockAmount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_MergeStock_OrderMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeStockAmount" targetRef="Gateway_MergeColorHandling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_OrderColor_OrderMerge" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Gateway_MergeColorHandling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_ColorHandling_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeColorHandling" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Split_Heat" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Split_GCode" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGCode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Heat_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_GCode_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGCode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Join_Print" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Print_End" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_ModelPrinted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveSketches" name="Receive sketches and project request">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_Start_Create</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProject" name="Create project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_Start_Create</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_Create_SendDraft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDraft" name="Send draft model" messageRef="Message_Draft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_Create_SendDraft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_Revise_SendDraft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_SendDraft_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForResponse" name="Wait for response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_SendDraft_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_Wait_ReceiveChanges</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_Wait_ReceiveApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveChanges" name="Receive requested changes" messageRef="Message_Changes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_Wait_ReceiveChanges</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_ReceiveChanges_Revise</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseModel" name="Make requested changes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_ReceiveChanges_Revise</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_Revise_SendDraft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApproval" name="Receive model approval" messageRef="Message_Approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_Wait_ReceiveApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_ReceiveApproval_SendSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSTL" name="Send STL file" messageRef="Message_STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_ReceiveApproval_SendSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_SendSTL_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_STLSent" name="STL file sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_SendSTL_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_Start_Create" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSketches" targetRef="Task_CreateProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_Create_SendDraft" sourceRef="Task_CreateProject" targetRef="Task_SendDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_SendDraft_Wait" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_Wait_ReceiveChanges" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_Wait_ReceiveApproval" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_ReceiveChanges_Revise" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveChanges" targetRef="Task_ReviseModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_Revise_SendDraft" sourceRef="Task_ReviseModel" targetRef="Task_SendDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_ReceiveApproval_SendSTL" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApproval" targetRef="Task_SendSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_SendSTL_End" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="End_STLSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches and project request" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Start_ReceiveSketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Draft model" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Requested changes" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveChanges" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Model approval" sourceRef="Task_SendApproval" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="STL file" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Continuous status updates during heating" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
